title: Statistician
text: Statistician at University of South Australia (Adelaide, ; Contract/Temp; salary: Salary range: $85,680 - $114,967 per annum). Located at SAHMRI, North Terrace, Adelaide CBD Full-time, two (2) year fixed term contract in the School of Pharmacy and Medical Sciences Salary range: $85,680 - $114,967 per annum (plus super) About the Job You will play a key statistician role and undertake a range of research-related activities for the Enhancing Joint Replacement Outcomes project, an Australian Orthopaedic Association National Joint Replacement Registry/National data linkage project funded by the National Health and Research Council (NHMRC). Skills and Experience With a post graduate qualification (level ARAS) or a PhD (level BRF) in a mathematics or statistics, you will bring experience working in a health-related environment with complex survival analyses and large-scale observational databases. Your programming experience using statistical software programs such as SAS, STATA or R (2 years minimum), together with an understanding of data management principles for large scale clinical research and probability and statistics theory will be essential. If you can provide expert statistical advice, analysis and reporting for complex research projects, write statistical sections for research papers and conference presentations and have the ability to build relationships in a multidisciplinary team, apply now! A University of Enterprise The University of South Australia (UniSA) is an innovative, outward-looking institution known for its strong and engaged research and its experientially-based teaching and learning that is conducted in close collaboration with business, industry, government and the professions. In recent years, we have maintained a strong upward trajectory across a number of key indicators and are ranked among the world’s top 50 young institutions. We are committed to international education activities and alumni, graduates who are equipped to meet the demands and expectations of the worldwide workforce, a culturally diverse staff and increasing student mobility. Benefits on Offer At UniSA, we seek to enrich people’s lives through the creation and application of knowledge. Our staff love to be a part of an organisational culture that promotes a strong commitment to educating professionals, sharing knowledge, and engaging with our communities. We offer a competitive remuneration package and we have a family friendly approach to ensure you enjoy a healthy work/life balance.
